title: Combination Sum
description:
Given distinct positive values in candidates, find every combination adding to target. You may use the same value repeatedly; combinations with the same values in a different pick order count only once.

Sort numbers within each combination in ascending order, then sort the outer list lexicographically by numeric values (shorter matching prefixes first). If target is zero, return [[]]; if no combination exists, return [].

Example 1:

Input: candidates = [2,3,6,7], target = 7
Output: [[2,2,3],[7]]
Explanation: Reusing 2 and adding 3 works; choosing 7 alone also works.

Example 2:

Input: candidates = [2,3,5], target = 8
Output: [[2,2,2,2],[2,3,3],[3,5]]
Explanation: There are three distinct nondecreasing combinations.

Example 3:

Input: candidates = [], target = 0
Output: [[]]
Explanation: The empty combination has sum zero.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= candidates.length <= 12
  • 1 <= candidates[i] <= 40; values are distinct
  • 0 <= target <= 40
